title: GTBench: A Curriculum-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs as Mathematical Research Assistants in Graph Theory
abstract: arXiv:2606.03144v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as self-study assistants in technical disciplines, yet their reliability as mathematical reasoning assistants remains poorly understood. We introduce GTBench, a curriculum-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLMs as mathematical research assistants in graph theory, comprising 63 problems organized into three groups of increasing difficulty: undergraduate definitions and basic properties (Group 1), algorithm tracing and structural reasoning (Group 2), and graduate-level proof construction (Group 3). Problems are sourced from verified academic materials including Diestel's Graph Theory. We evaluate five frontier models -- GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, Llama 3.3 70B, and Mistral Large 3 -- under zero-shot and chain-of-thought prompting, using exact-match and LLM-as-judge evaluation for Groups 1 and 2, and a hybrid human expert and LLM-as-judge protocol for Group 3. translated_title: GTBench：一个基于课程体系的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型作为图论数学研究助手的能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在技术学科中被越来越多地用作自学助手，但它们作为数学推理助手的可靠性仍缺乏充分了解。我们提出了GTBench，这是一个基于课程体系的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型作为图论数学研究助手的能力，包含63道题目，按难度递增分为三组：本科阶段的定义与基本性质（第1组）、算法追踪与结构推理（第2组），以及研究生水平的证明构造（第3组）。题目来源于经过验证的学术材料，包括Diestel的《图论》教材。我们在零样本和思维链（chain-of-thought）提示设置下评估了五个前沿模型——GPT-5、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite、Llama 3.3 70B和Mistral Large 3——对第1组和第2组采用精确匹配和LLM-as-judge评估方法，对第3组采用人类专家与LLM-as-judge相结合的混合评估协议。
tldr: 本文提出了GTBench——一个基于图论课程体系、包含63道按三级难度组织题目的基准测试，用于系统评估大语言模型作为数学研究助手在定义理解、算法推理和证明构造方面的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GTBench, a curriculum-grounded benchmark of 63 graph theory problems organized into three difficulty levels, designed to systematically evaluate LLMs as mathematical research assistants in definition recall, algorithmic reasoning, and proof construction.
